asm webapp-language(1)					BIG-IP TMSH Manual				    asm webapp-language(1)

NAME
       webapp-language - Lists the available languages that can be used in the context of the httpclass-asm profile.

MODULE
       asm

SYNTAX
       Retrieve the list of the webapp-language values using the syntax shown in the following sections.

   DISPLAY
	list webapp-language
	list webapp-language [ [ [name] | [glob] ... ]
	  options:
	    all
	    one-line

DESCRIPTION
       Use this command to display the possible values of the webapp-language object to be used in the context of the httpclass-
       asm profile.  This is for advanced usage - this command is intended to be used by the application templates system.

EXAMPLES
       list webapp-language

       Displays all the languages supported by the ASM.

SEE ALSO
       asm httpclass-asm, glob, list, tmsh
